data.body: [P1] Approach: Reconsider the speculative resume during SUSPENDING. The stated benefit is saving one poll in the fallback path; `ensureRunning` already handles SUSPENDING by waiting for SUSPENDED. Adding an eager resume and its separate error handling for that optimization breaks rule 1.1. The description also neither substantiates acceptance during SUSPENDING nor marks that assumption unverified, as rule 6 requires; its reported cloud test resumes an already suspended VM. Return to the design phase under rule 8 and consider sharing the existing polling/resume flow.
